page_title: FRE 5-0 WER | Freiburg v Werder Bremen 21/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Max Burda is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' 5 - 0 Goal! Jan-Niklas Beste plays a pass to the feet of Ritsu Doan (Freiburg), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 5:0.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
86' Substitution. Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) in, Amos Pieper out.

85' That didn't go as planned! Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Noah Atubolu, who easily kept it out.
82' Here's the change. Maximilian Eggestein leaves the pitch and Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) comes on as a substitute.
82' Julian Schuster has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) replacing Christian Gunter.
80' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) and Kiliann Sildillia perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lucas Holer walks off the pitch to be replaced by Junior Adamu (Freiburg).

76' 4 - 0 Eren Dinkci passes to Ritsu Doan (Freiburg), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom right corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 4:0.
75' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender.
75' The ball possession is 33:67.
72' It's time for a substitution. Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) comes on in place of Andre Silva.
71' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) replaces Vincenzo Grifo.
71' Substitution. Merlin Rohl will be replaced by Eren Dinkci (Freiburg).
70' The linesman makes the right call and Werder Bremen will have a corner.
69' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
69' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Lucas Holer (Freiburg).
68' Werder Bremen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
66' Max Burda blows his whistle after Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
62' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
61' The referee signals a substitution. Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) is brought on as a substitute for Derrick Kohn.
61' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Leonardo Bittencourt and he is replaced by Jens Stage (Werder Bremen).
60' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Justin Njinmah.
59' There's an opportunity for Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

57' 3 - 0 It's a goal! Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) scores with a brilliant shot into the left side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Lucas Holer. The score is now 3:0.
54' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes the corner with a short pass.
52' Freiburg are ruled offside.
50' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
48' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Werder Bremen force a corner. They send men into the box.
45+1' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
40' The ball goes behind for a corner. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

39' Andre Silva (Werder Bremen) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot inside the right post. Noah Atubolu anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
39' Andre Silva (Werder Bremen) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
39' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Werder Bremen!
37' Referee Max Burda makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Werder Bremen. Let’s see what happens!
35' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
34' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
33' 2 - 0 Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) scores a great goal from the resulting free kick from mid-range. He sends the ball directly inside the right post.
32' A free kick on the edge of the box for Freiburg. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
30' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
29' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
28' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) will take a corner kick.
26' 2:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
23' It seemed like Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
21' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) picks up a yellow card.

18' Romano Schmid sends a lovely lofted pass forward that flies over the top of the defence and into the path of Andre Silva (Werder Bremen), but he can't direct his header on target as it flies well wide of the right post.
15' 1 - 0 GOAL! Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) gets to the rebound inside the box and fires in a stunning overhead kick. Phenomenal finish! 1:0.
15' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
14' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
12' The Werder Bremen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
8' Andre Silva (Werder Bremen) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
5' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) and Amos Pieper matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
3' A header by Christian Gunter (Freiburg) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past Michael Zetterer, who makes a nice save.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Max Burda.
